site.anchor: em prejuízo do cônjuge, na constância da sociedade conjugal (art. 181, I)

source.quote: do cônjuge, na constância da sociedade conjugal;

readings.description: Spouses separated in fact, with no judicial or notarial separation, are still in the conjugal society: the Código Civil ends it only by death, nullity, judicial separation or divorce. The absolute immunity applies.

citations.cite: Código Civil, art. 1.571 (causes that end the sociedade conjugal)

readings.description: A de facto separation ends the 'constância' of the conjugal society for art. 181 I, since the life in common that justifies the immunity has ended.
readings.foreclosure: The Code's words name a legal status, and the Código Civil lists the causes that end it; a factual separation is not among them. No court position was fetched.

taken.rationale: The phrase names a legal status. The encoding records the tie as an input member, `casado com a vítima, separado de fato`, and treats it as within art. 181 I, so a reviewer who prefers the other reading changes one arm.

notes: Raised by sweep-b's note to F-sweep-b-23 ('de facto separated spouses may now keep the absolute immunity ... unverified'). No criminal decision was fetched.

site.anchor: crime de roubo ou de extorsão, ou com grave ameaça ou violência à pessoa (art. 183, I)

source.quote: se o crime é de roubo ou de extorsão, ou, em geral, quando haja emprego de grave ameaça ou violência à pessoa;

readings.description: 'extorsão' is every crime the Code so names: art. 158 (extorsão), art. 159 (extorsão mediante sequestro) and art. 160 (extorsão indireta).

Only the extortions committed with violence or grave threat (arts. 158 and 159); art. 160, which uses neither, is outside the exception, since the rest of inciso I ('em geral, quando haja emprego de grave ameaça ou violência') shows what the exception is about.
readings.foreclosure: The first limb names crimes, not means; art. 160 is named 'extorsão indireta' by the Code itself.

taken.rationale: The limb names the crimes, and the Code's own rubric calls art. 160 an extorsão. The reading is the wider exception; it withdraws an immunity, so a court may read it narrowly.

source.quote_absent_reason: The dates are not in the Code's text; they come from each amending law's vigência clause, outside the source bundle.

readings.description: The day each amending law came into force, from its DOU date and its own vigência clause, counting a vacatio legis as LC 95/1998 art. 8º § 1º does (publication day included; in force the day after the last day): art. 183 III 1.1.2004; art. 183-A 10.9.2024; art. 168-A 15.10.2000; § 4º of art. 168-A 10.1.2018; art. 171-A 20.6.2023; art. 158 § 3º 17.4.2009; art. 163 p.ú. III 8.12.2017; art. 172 28.12.1990; art. 180 (caput to § 4º) 26.12.1996.

citations.cite: each law's vigência clause, read on Planalto on 2026-09-29/30

readings.description: For Lei nº 9.983/2000, which predates LC 107/2001's counting rule, excluding the publication day and starting the next day gives 16.10.2000.

citations.cite: Lei nº 9.983/2000, art. 4º ('noventa dias após a data de sua publicação')

readings.foreclosure: Both the inclusive count and '90 days after publication' give 15.10.2000; only one of three methods gives the 16th, and no quotable source states the date.

The research helper read every clause on Planalto; the 168-A date is computed, not confirmed by a quotable source. These are the laws' own answers: before those days the provisions were not law (arts. 183 III, 183-A, 168-A, 171-A, 158 § 3º), or their earlier words are not in the source and the encoding refuses (arts. 163 p.ú. III, 172, 180).

readings.description: § 3º needs the result to come from the VIOLENCE, not from a threat alone; 'lesão corporal grave' covers both grades of art. 129, §§ 1º and 2º (the gravíssima grade is graver still).

site.anchor: a forma do roubo que governa

source.quote: aplica-se em dobro a pena prevista no caput deste artigo. ... aplica-se em triplo a pena prevista no caput deste artigo, desprezadas as demais causas de aumento.

readings.description: The forms with their own preceito (caput and § 1º, § 1º-A, § 3º I, § 3º II, § 5º) and the caput's pena doubled (§ 2º-B) or tripled (§ 4º) are candidate penas; the heaviest governs (larger maximum, then larger minimum). §§ 2º and 2º-A reach the caput, § 1º-A and § 2º-B, which they follow in the text; not § 3º or § 5º, which follow them. Under § 4º every other cause, art. 183-A's included, is disregarded.

citations.cite: STJ, Tema 1087 (the topographic argument, for art. 155)

readings.description: §§ 2º-B and 4º are causes applied to whichever pena governs, and §§ 2º and 2º-A reach every form.
readings.rejection_rationale: § 4º tripling § 3º II would give 72–90 years, and § 5º exists precisely for that case; the words 'pena prevista no caput' tie both paragraphs to the caput.

readings.description: A form qualified by the result (§ 3º) always governs over § 2º-B and § 4º.
readings.foreclosure: With a restricted firearm and a serious injury this gives 7–18 against § 2º-B's 12–20; no rule of the Code picks the lighter.

taken.rationale: As F-g0-18 reads art. 155. Consequences a reviewer should see: a restricted firearm with serious injury is governed by § 2º-B (12–20); § 4º with serious injury by § 4º (18–30), injury weighing only at art. 59; § 5º (20–40) governs the organised latrocínio although its minimum is below § 3º II's 24 since Lei 15.397/2026.

source.quote_absent_reason: The fork is about the encoding's scope, not about the words of one article.

citations.cite: Lei nº 12.015/2009, art. 7º (revoga o art. 224 do CP)

source.quote: Art. 9º As penas fixadas no art. 6º para os crimes capitulados nos arts. 157, § 3º, 158, § 2º, 159, caput e seus §§ 1º, 2º e 3º, ... são acrescidas de metade, respeitado o limite superior de trinta anos de reclusão, estando a vítima em qualquer das hipóteses referidas no art. 224 também do Código Penal.

readings.description: No. Its only trigger is 'qualquer das hipóteses referidas no art. 224', and art. 224 has not existed since 10.8.2009. The increase has no operative condition.
Yes, read through art. 217-A's 'vulnerável', which absorbed the old art. 224 presumptions.
readings.rejection_rationale: The STF (HC 100.181/RS) held the increase inapplicable once its reference rule was suppressed, and an increase by analogy in malam partem runs into CP art. 1º.

taken.rationale: The increase is not encoded for facts from 10.8.2009. For earlier facts it could apply, and art. 224's words are not in the source: art. 159's penalty rules refuse before 10.8.2009. Arts. 157 § 3º and 158 § 2º refuse before 4.5.2026 on other grounds, so the question does not arise there.

settled_by.citation: HC 100.181/RS: "A causa de aumento prevista no art. 9º da Lei de Crimes Hediondos faz referência ao art. 224 do Código Penal, que foi revogado pela Lei 12.015/2009. Suprimida a regra de referência, resulta inaplicável a majoração da pena."

notes: Both decisions are rape cases; applying the holding to arts. 157 § 3º, 158 § 2º and 159 is this encoder's inference from the same reasoning (the reference rule is gone). Quotations from LexML's case pages, read by the research helper on 2026-09-29.

site.anchor: a punibilidade está extinta (art. 168-A)

source.quote: § 2o É extinta a punibilidade se o agente, espontaneamente, declara, confessa e efetua o pagamento das contribuições, importâncias ou valores e presta as informações devidas à previdência social, na forma definida em lei ou regulamento, antes do início da ação fiscal.

readings.description: Full payment by the related legal entity extinguishes punishability whenever made, per Lei 10.684 art. 9º § 2º. Neither applies to a declared devedor contumaz (art. 9º §§ 3º–4º, from LC 225/2026).
Only the Code's § 2º: payment before the ação fiscal begins.
readings.rejection_rationale: STF RHC 128.245/SP: payment 'ainda que após o trânsito em julgado da condenação' extinguishes punishability under Lei 10.684 art. 9º § 2º.

readings.description: Lei 9.430 art. 83 as amended in 2011 governs: extinction only on full payment of a parcelled debt.
readings.foreclosure: The STF's 2016 holding applies Lei 10.684 art. 9º § 2º to art. 168-A directly.

taken.rationale: Encoded as a separate ground beside § 2º, with its own input (`a pessoa jurídica pagou integralmente os débitos, inclusive acessórios`) and LC 225's carve-out for acts from 9.1.2026 (§ 6º: the status at the time of the act). The parcelamento's suspension of the pretensão punitiva (art. 9º caput) is not encoded.

settled_by.citation: RHC 128.245/SP: "Tratando-se de apropriação indébita previdenciária (art. 168-A, § 1º, I, CP), o pagamento integral do débito tributário, ainda que após o trânsito em julgado da condenação, é causa de extinção da punibilidade do agente, nos termos do art. 9º, § 2º, da Lei nº 10.684/03."

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 158, § 4º

source.quote: § 4º Se os crimes previstos neste artigo são cometidos por integrante de organização criminosa, grupo paramilitar ou milícia privada, no contexto da atuação ou para a consecução das condutas previstas, aplica-se em triplo a respectiva pena.

readings.description: Read systematically with arts. 121 § 2º-D, 155 § 9º, 157 § 4º and 159 § 5º, all inserted by the same Lei 15.358 art. 33: an ultraviolent criminal organisation, paramilitary group or private militia, acting in the context of or for the conducts of Lei 15.358 art. 2º.
readings.foreclosure: Not taken, by the conductor's ruling of 2026-09-30 (house rule: isomorphic to the text). It narrows the enacted words to match the siblings' wording, correcting what M-sweep-b-43 records as a drafting divergence in Lei 15.358 itself; in dubio pro reo favours it, and a court may read § 4º this way.

readings.description: As enacted: any 'organização criminosa' (an ultraviolent one included), paramilitary group or private militia, 'no contexto da atuação ou para a consecução das condutas previstas'. The context clause is taken in its own words; 'condutas previstas' names no law, so whether the act was in that context is a fact the fact supplier certifies. The result is a broader tripling than the siblings'.

taken.rationale: The text as enacted is what is encoded (conductor's ruling, 2026-09-30). The rule reads membership of an `organização criminosa`, an `organização criminosa ultraviolenta`, a `grupo paramilitar` or a `milícia privada`, and the case record's field `no contexto da atuação ou para a consecução das condutas previstas (art. 158, § 4º)`, which mirrors the words. A plain criminal organisation acting in that context triggers the tripling; the test `a extorsão da organização comum` witnesses it, and `a extorsão da organização fora do contexto` shows membership alone is not enough.

notes: Ruled by the conductor on 2026-09-30: encode as written. Until then the encoding took `lidoComoOsDemais`, and `a extorsão da organização comum` had no § 4º increase; that test now expects the tripling.
cp-dominio's comment on `Grupo criminoso` says art. 158 § 4º 'names the plain one'; the encoding now agrees with it.

site.anchor: em prejuízo do cônjuge desquitado ou judicialmente separado (art. 182, I)

source.quote: I - do cônjuge desquitado ou judicialmente separado;

readings.description: On the text: art. 182 I reaches the 'cônjuge desquitado ou judicialmente separado', a class Tema 1053 closes (the desquitados and those judicially separated before the thesis). A divorced spouse is neither, so arts. 181 and 182 do not reach the divorced and the crime keeps its own ação penal (art. 100: pública incondicionada unless the article says otherwise). Couples who split later without divorcing are still married and fall under art. 181 I.

citations.cite: STF Tema 1.053 (RE 1.167.478), thesis as reproduced by TJRJ

readings.description: As above, and also spouses separated by public deed (Lei 11.441/2007), whose status Tema 1053 preserves in the same breath.
readings.foreclosure: The words do not decide it: 'judicialmente' is in the 1940 text, when every separation went through a court, and the deed came with Lei 11.441/2007, so the word may mark a legal separation against a de facto one rather than exclude the deed. Argued both ways, no criminal decision fetched: the encoding refuses for a spouse separated by public deed, the one margin still undecided.

readings.description: Art. 182 I extends by analogy in bonam partem to divorced spouses.
readings.foreclosure: Not taken, by the conductor's ruling of 2026-09-30: an analogy in bonam partem the text does not make. The text decides the divorced spouse, and sweep-b's M-sweep-b-45 says the same ('divorced, which neither art. 181 nor art. 182 names'). A court could still extend the relative immunity pro reo.

taken.rationale: Settled on the text by the conductor's ruling of 2026-09-30. The desquitado or judicially separated spouse is under art. 182 I. The divorced spouse is under neither art. 181 nor art. 182: `o efeito dos arts. 181 a 183` answers `nem o art. 181 nem o art. 182 se aplicam`, and the ação penal is the crime's own. For a spouse separated by public deed the text does not decide, and the encoding keeps its refusal (`o alcance do art. 182, I, ao separado por escritura pública não está decidido nesta codificação`); art. 183 is asked first, so the refusal is reached only where it would decide the case.

notes: Ruled by the conductor on 2026-09-30. Until then the encoding refused for the divorced spouse as well; `o furto entre divorciados` now expects `nem o art. 181 nem o art. 182 se aplicam`.
The spouse separated by public deed still refuses: the ruling left that margin to the text, which does not decide it.

delegated_field: the seller's knowledge of what he sold: `o agente sabia que a coisa vendida era falsa, deteriorada ou de outra qualidade` (art. 175, caput, I, and § 1º, selling a false stone or a metal of another quality)

site.anchor: o agente sabia que a coisa vendida era falsa, deteriorada ou de outra qualidade

source.quote: Parágrafo único - Salvo os casos expressos em lei, ninguém pode ser punido por fato previsto como crime, senão quando o pratica dolosamente.

readings.description: The seller's knowledge of what the thing is (forged, spoiled, a false stone, a metal of another quality) is part of the dolo, and an error about it excludes dolo (art. 20). It is the court's finding, supplied on the case; absent, there is no crime under caput I or the selling verbs of § 1º. Not knowing that the law forbids such a sale would be art. 21 and is not encoded.
The existing field `no exercício de atividade comercial, enganando o adquirente ou consumidor` already carries the seller's knowledge.
readings.rejection_rationale: That field states the result (the buyer was in fact deceived), which is true of a retailer who sold forged stock in good faith as much as of a swindler. It says nothing about what the seller knew, so a good-faith retailer was convicted. Measured in a scratch copy: with the knowledge requirement removed the three new no-crime tests fail.

taken.rationale: A positive local finding named after its object, read by the three selling verbs. Same convention as F-g5-34.

witnesses: cp-g3-outras-fraudes-testes.l4: `o varejista que tomava a mercadoria por genuína`, `o joalheiro que tomava a pedra por verdadeira`, `o vendedor que tomava o metal por precioso` → no crime; `o ourives que trocou a pedra encomendada` → crime without the finding
notes: Checked and left without the finding: caput II 'entregar uma mercadoria por outra' (the agent's own substitution; a clerk's honest mix-up is the arguable edge, left to the fact and to art. 20 as the court reads it), § 1º 'alterar em obra encomendada a qualidade ou o peso de metal' and 'substituir, em obra encomendada, pedra verdadeira por falsa ou por outra de menor valor' (the agent's own acts on work entrusted to him, so the knowledge is implied). Art. 175 has no culpable form, so no three-valued finding is needed.

site.anchor: a pena cominada ao art. 177

source.quote: Pena - reclusão, de um a quatro anos, e multa, se o fato não constitui crime contra a economia popular.

readings.description: A fact outside the crime gets no penalty from the article: the penalty rule REFUSEs unless the crime predicate holds. `a pena cominada ao art. 177` refuses unless `crime do art. 177`; `a pena cominada à receptação (art. 180)` refuses unless `crime de receptação (art. 180)`. Results for in-crime facts are unchanged.
The last branch (art. 177 § 2º, art. 180 § 3º) is the default for whatever is not the earlier branches.
readings.rejection_rationale: Measured with mut-g3's probe: a false prospectus that is a crime against the popular economy (outside the caput, not a vote sale) got § 2º's detenção of 6 to 24 months and multa, with exit 0 and no warning. A lawyer reading the answer would take it as the Code's penalty for a fact the article does not reach.

taken.rationale: The penalty rules guard on the crime predicates the same module already exports and REFUSE otherwise, as the vigência gates do.
